ValidationRule.description: The Legacey: landowner unit (LL Share Name filled, not BUILDER) needs AGPA Date and Number on create/edit. Updates that only change Status / Current Booking (quote, booking, cancel, swap) are allowed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Project__r.Name = "The Legacey", NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(LL_Share_Name__c))), TEXT(LL_Share_Name__c) <> "BUILDER", OR(ISBLANK(AGPA_Date__c), ISBLANK(AGPA_Number__c)), OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(LL_Share_Name__c), ISCHANGED(AGPA_Date__c), ISCHANGED(AGPA_Number__c), NOT(OR(ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISCHANGED(Current_Booking__c))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: AGPA Date and AGPA Number are required for a landowner unit (LL Share Name other than BUILDER) in The Legacey.
